maya.cs Hey team — quick sync: we need to send out a small cohort sampling invite to 12 preview customers (Tecton, Orbis, Lumen) this week to capture structured feedback on the onboarding checklist. I sketched an outreach plan below.
rohan.cs +1 on doing a lean send. timeline?
alex.pm Need to align w/ enablement content updates first — two slides changed last sprint. Can we freeze copy by Thu EOD?
sophie.eng FYI: engineering will be on-call for any API key issues during the outreach window (Fri-Mon). Ping me if anyone sees 401 spikes.
maya.cs Plan: draft invite, ask customers to complete a 5-min checklist + 1x 30-min interview. Draft out now, send Thurs AM, interviews next week.
rohan.cs I can own invites and calendaring. Will use the existing invite template but add a 2-line TL;DR and a quick consent blurb.
rohan.cs Draft invite snippet: "Hi — thanks for joining our preview. Would you try the onboarding runner and fill a 5-min checklist? We'll follow up for a short interview to capture friction + improvement ideas. Slot booking link here: <link>" Thoughts?
alex.pm Looks good. Add a checkbox option for 'prefer async feedback' so we don't force interviews.
maya.cs Good call. Also add the renewal-risk flag in the form (low/medium/high) so CS can flag accounts that need attention.
sophie.eng Also include a checkbox for SDK language(s) used — that helps us route to eng faster.
calendar-bot Meeting created: "Cohort Sampling Interviews" Thu 11:00-12:00 — maya.cs, rohan.cs, alex.pm invited. (link)
maya.cs Awesome — rohan can you run the send and paste the final invite here once ready? I'll QA the checklist questions and the renewal-risk tag.
rohan.cs Will do. Sending a short pilot to 3 accounts first, then the rest after we confirm copy. Targeting Thurs 9:30am for the pilot send.
maya.cs Perfect. If pilot looks good we'll mass-send at 11:00. Also leave a note in Gainsight: "sampling invite sent, pilot run ok".
alex.pm I'll update the enablement slides now and post the link once done.
maya.cs Thanks — let's reconvene post-pilot in this thread. :thumbsup:
